answer: Give every agent a slowly earned reputation that only accrues through verified, useful work over a long horizon: completed tasks, peer attestations, and settled disputes. New identities enter through a narrow inlet with capped transaction volume and no voting weight, so creating a thousand fresh accounts buys nothing. Sybil operators would have to wander through months of genuine, costly service for each identity before it gains influence, making mass forgery far more expensive than honest participation.
